note: v0.30.0 — curve handles: the selected stroke edited as a cubic Bézier, fitted over its points and sampled back
the pen travels every head and tail: no skipped ink at joins, chain ends walked to the ink's tips, dots are dabs
the stroke renderer is the default; its profiles are fitted to the outline and widths can be set by hand in the editor
v0.27.0 — stroke renderer prototype: the pen's ribbon is the letter, switchable beside the outline reveal
v0.26.0 — a join's corridor is drawn by the bands alone while the pen is near it
v0.25.0 — through a join the width runs from one letter's clean width to the other's
v0.24.0 — joins are one band under the letters, sharing their end cross-sections; bands have the nib's round front
v0.23.0 — the pen model is retired; the font route is the only source
v0.22.0 — a crossbar is its own stroke: the J no longer climbs its stem to finish the bar; Ms Madi bundled
v0.21.0 — strokes are drawn as vector bands in pen order; the reveal map only fills in behind them
v0.20.0 — junctions: a stroke keeps its line and its width through a crossing, to the half-pixel; a pointed pen's hairline stays thin inside a shade
v0.19.0 — junctions: a stroke keeps its own width where another crosses it, and leftover ink joins the nearest path
v0.18.0 — Export movie: a .mov with alpha (ProRes 4444 or HEVC), rendered on a fixed clock and encoded with AVFoundation
v0.17.1 — revert the retrace rule that drew an o's swirl early; let a band travel through ink it may not claim
